$comment: Enumerated, dated exemptions from the exact-pinning rule enforced by
scripts/check-pins.mjs. This file is NOT a way to make pinning optional:
every entry must name a reason and a blocking decision, check-pins fails if
a waived specifier has become exact (a stale waiver must be deleted), and it

dead-entry.why: The 'dreams' workspace is disabled in pnpm-workspace.yaml, so this catalog entry resolves to nothing and cannot enter the dependency graph. There is no resolved version to pin it to.
dead-entry.blocked_on: Dependency-removal handling, deliberately deferred until the foundation is stable.
dead-entry.retires: When the entry is deleted, or the dreams workspace is re-enabled and the entry is pinned.
